positions.title: Executive Assistant
positions.description:
Ensure follow-through of all discussed items in meetings. Provide updates until completed.
Provide support to customers, donors, and contractors
Manage company-wide programs, including:
Banking
Company website
Accounts Payable and Receivable (Quickbooks)
Facilitate the publishing process of English books.
Organized and executed a retreat weekend for party of 150+

positions.title: Full Stack Web Development Student
positions.description:
A four-month full-stack web development bootcamp. Core technologies included Ruby, Rails, JavaScript, and Vue.js. Special emphasis on API-driven development, version control with git, professional tooling, team collaboration, and continual learning.

InvenStory: I personally built an app that allows employees to track inventory between locations to ensure accurate inventory count.

Skills: GitHub · Ruby · Ruby on Rails · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Git · PostgreSQL · Web Development  · Databases · Software Development · Vue · Web Applications
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · Web Development · GitHub · JavaScript · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Business Office Manager
positions.description:
Prepare census report
Prepare and ensure completion of Medicaid applications
Manage RFMS banking for the residents in our facility
Communicate with residents and their families in regards to any financial concerns.
Complete all duties in regards to Human Resources including:
         -Arrange interviews for applicants
         -Onboard new hires
         -Prepare and close payroll of 60 employees bi-weekly
         -Address employee complaints and concerns

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description:

-Processed blood, saliva, and tumor for further scientific benefit
